theory.heading: What MCP Security Boundaries is
theory.body: MCP Security Boundaries describes the methods and patterns used within Agentic AI to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why MCP Security Boundaries matters
theory.body: Without MCP Security Boundaries, systems built with Agentic AI are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How MCP Security Boundaries works
theory.body: The mechanism behind MCP Security Boundaries follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of MCP Security Boundaries.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of MCP Security Boundaries
theory.body: MCP Security Boundaries offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
